blocks.title: A reader in another language
blocks.body: A Python reader written from the standard alone passes the same conformance suite as the TypeScript one.

blocks.title: Four sites you can run
blocks.body: A minimal Astro site, Paraline's motion-heavy studio, a bakery on Next.js and a writer's journal on SvelteKit, all reading the same standard.
